children: Gold continues to rise in early Asian trade after rallying overnight. A broad risk-on tone across markets after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO has supported the precious metal's prices, ANZ Research analysts say in a research note. Lower oil prices overnight also spur hope that inflation will be tamed in coming months, and thus ease pressure the Federal Reserve to hike rates, they say. Capital Economics holds a more bearish view on gold, warning that its prices could fall to $3,500 per troy ounce by the end of the year as long as the Fed remains hawkish and equities are trending lower. Spot gold is 0.6% higher at $3,653.19 a troy ounce.(sherry.qin@wsj.com)
